summary: CICS online Transaction List screen. Displays a scrollable, paginated list of transactions from the transaction file, with forward/backward paging (PF7/PF8). The user can select a transaction to view its detail. Pseudo-conversational, carrying the paging position in the COMMAREA.

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.pseudocode: Pseudo-conversational entry. On first entry send the first page of transactions. On re-entry evaluate the key: PF3 return; PF7 page backward; PF8 page forward; Enter select a transaction. Return to CICS with the COMMAREA.
branches: EVALUATE EIBAID: PF3 / PF7 / PF8 / ENTER

paragraphs.name: PROCESS-PF7-KEY
paragraphs.pseudocode: Handle the page-backward key: page the transaction list backward.

paragraphs.name: PROCESS-PF8-KEY
paragraphs.pseudocode: Handle the page-forward key: page the transaction list forward.

paragraphs.name: PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD
paragraphs.pseudocode: Browse the transaction file forward from the last key shown, filling the next page of rows until full or end-of-file; if at the end, show 'end of list'.
branches: READNEXT loop until page full or EOF

paragraphs.name: PROCESS-PAGE-BACKWARD
paragraphs.pseudocode: Browse the transaction file backward from the first key shown, filling the previous page of rows until full or top-of-file; if at the top, show 'top of list'.
branches: READPREV loop until page full or BOF

paragraphs.name: POPULATE-TRAN-DATA
paragraphs.pseudocode: Move a read transaction into the next on-screen row (id, date, description, amount).

paragraphs.name: INITIALIZE-TRAN-DATA
paragraphs.pseudocode: Clear the on-screen transaction rows before repopulating.

paragraphs.name: SEND-TRNLST-SCREEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Populate the header and send the transaction-list map.

paragraphs.name: RECEIVE-TRNLST-SCREEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Receive the transaction-list map from the terminal.

paragraphs.name: POPULATE-HEADER-INFO
paragraphs.pseudocode: Populate the screen header (title, date, time, ids).

paragraphs.name: STARTBR-TRANSACT-FILE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Start a browse of the transaction file at the current position.

paragraphs.name: READNEXT-TRANSACT-FILE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the next transaction in the browse.

paragraphs.name: READPREV-TRANSACT-FILE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the previous transaction in the browse.

paragraphs.name: RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Return control to the previous menu/screen.
